name: Coco Loco sound mixer
drawing: Coco Loco schematic, which this site does not hold -- via MAME's netlist
revision: Coco Loco, sound: the AY-3-8910's three channels through 4.7K resistors into a 5K volume pot, and through 10uF to the LM383 amplifier.
coverage: 0 ICs, 5 other parts and 7 nets over 11 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist, up to the LM383 power amplifier's input; the amplifier is not in MAME. Not compared with a sheet: it is MAME's reading as MAME has it, and the notes say why. It has no ICs, so there is no board view: the netlist and the bill of materials carry it.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
